purpose: How a future, separately reviewed adapter may surface P0..P5 research status in the read-only daily brief without ever displaying an unvalidated stock selection.

inputRecord.asOfSignalDate: ISO date of the latest completed week-end session
inputRecord.productionArm: always P0 unless an arm reaches G6 (ADMITTED inputs AND a passing verdict in portfolio-d-p0-p5-comparison-v1)
inputRecord.evidence: {verifiedAccount: null, prospectivePaper: {maturedBlocks, firstVerdictNotBefore}, historicalDevelopment: 'never shown in the brief'}

displayRules: If productionArm is P0: print 'KR 0개 · 069500.KS 100%' or 'US 0개 · SPY 100%'. QQQ may appear only as a labelled secondary comparison row.
Never print a ticker or a weight from an arm whose displayableToReport is false.
A research arm may be listed only as '<arm>: 연구 기록 중 · 미검증' with its receipt count, never with names.
Verified real-account performance is '없음' (never 0%); prospective paper and historical development performance are separate rows and are never summed.
An arm with fewer matured non-overlapping H126 blocks than firstVerdictNotBefore is labelled '판정 전' (descriptive only).
validation: comparison.arm_receipt sets displayableToReport from armStatus; an adapter must refuse any record where displayableToReport is false but targets contain a non-ETF ticker it was asked to display.
